Name: Forest Fairy Buildings - Winter House Fix
Author: stardewfairy5
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Fixes the misalignment in the seasonal winter house that gives an extra space between your house and mailbox.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download and Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32513]Chobab's Forest Fairy Farm Seasonal Buildings[/url] if you haven't already.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Download and Extract this mod's file[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Copy and Paste png to [CP] Forest Fairy Farm Buildings/assets/Buildings/Houses or Houses_2 (depending on which seasonal summer house your using. If unsure just copy and paste the png into both files.)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Click Replace the file in this destination when prompted.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]If you need any help feel free to ask me in the comments![/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32513]Chobab's Forest Fairy Farm Seasonal Buildings[/url] to work!!![/color]
